snippet.title: Super Mario Bros. S v0.0.1 Showcase
snippet.description:
This video showcases many of the new features coming up in Super Mario Bros. S v0.0.1 on Unity. There's still a lot for me to do, so no planned release date yet.

SMBS Discord: https://discord.com/invite/W5ENqE5kVS
SMBS Scratch Studio: https://scratch.mit.edu/studios/25367176/

Music is the old Super Mario Multiverse Athletic theme, composed by Mad Nyle: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GuDqEcv2nYQ

New features include:
- Rigidbody-based physics system
- Widescreen
- New gamemode
- New Luigi sprites
- Improved blade star graphics
- Improved ice flower graphics
- Improved frozen enemy physics
- Rail and circle controllers
- Galagan Hornets
- Fuzzies
- Munchers
- Bull's-eye Bills
- Wide blocks
- Seesaws (in development)
- Pro Controller Support (partial)
